question: Describe the logged sleep timing in this synthetic window.

claims.text: Across three logged main-sleep intervals from October 18–20, the median recorded duration was 480 minutes and the median logged midpoint was 02:30 in America/Denver.

support.rationale: This is the deterministic summary of three synthetic input intervals; the calculation describes logs only.

claims.text: These logs do not estimate circadian phase or establish sleep quality, health, or schedule adequacy.

support.rationale: The summary method explicitly limits its interpretation to logged interval timing and duration.

limitations: Synthetic example only; no person or device export is represented.
The reading must select, index, and authorize the summary's input records as well as the derived summary.
